svg.text: WorkSpaces on a closed VPC with AWS Managed Microsoft AD
Direct connection from standard PCs restricted by IP access control group; no IGW / NAT; OUs, groups, PSO and GPOs built by SSM; monthly last-connection report
VPC 10.97.220.0/23 — no internet gateway, no NAT
Reserved for a later Transit Gateway attachment (no TGW / no route yet)
joins into OU=Admin; builds OUs / groups
Windows only / no reconnect / no self-service
